description: Verify that DUT TCP uses 2*MSL upper bound on SYN-segment RTO (RFC 1122 §4.2.3.1 p96 SHOULD)
approach:
[Objective]
Mirror of RETRANSMISSION_TO_08 for SYN retx during active OPEN. Same 2*MSL ceiling.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT active OPEN → SYN → tester drops all SYNs.
2. DUT retransmits with doubling RTO.
3. TCP_INFO query → RTO plateau ≤ 2*MSL.

[Pass condition]
Same as TO_08 but for SYN.

[Fail condition]
Same fail set as TO_08.

verdicts.Pass: DUT SYN RTO plateaued at 2*MSL — normal
verdicts.Fail_handshake_did_not_complete: DUT active OPEN did not initiate
verdicts.Fail_no_retx: No SYN retransmits observed in kernel
verdicts.Fail_rto_above_2msl_cap: RTO plateau above 2*MSL (Linux RTO max 120 s exceeds spec)
verdicts.Fail_rto_below_2msl_cap: RTO below 2*MSL did not plateau within observation budget
